name: ai-for-business-hackathon
description: Fullstack AI Hackathon Monorepo: React Client + Express Backend + FastAPI AI Service

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "CLIENT,BACKEND,AI" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix backend install && cd ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
